prompt: Lower-bound step, in one line: if a[mid] is less than `target`, move lo to mid + 1; otherwise move hi to mid. Write it as an if/else on a single line.
answer: if (a[mid] < target) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;
why: If a[mid] is too small, the answer is to the right: lo = mid + 1; otherwise hi = mid. That finds the lower bound.
